title: Bilvashtakam
intro: Bilvashtakam is a sacred hymn describing the importance of Bilva leaves offered to Lord Shiva. Read lyrics, meaning, and benefits.
description:
tridalam trigunakaram trinetram cha triyayudham ।
trijanmapapasamharam ekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 1 ॥

trishakhaih bilvapatraishcha hyachchhidraih komalaih shubhaih ।
shivapujam karishyami hyekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 2 ॥

akhanda bilva patrena pujite nandikeshware ।
shuddhyanti sarvapapebhyo hyekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 3 ॥

shaligrama shilamekam vipranam jatu charpayet ।
somayajna mahapunyam ekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 4 ॥

dantikoti sahasrani vajapeya shatani cha ।
kotikanya mahadanam ekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 5 ॥

lakshmyastanuta utpannam mahadevasya cha priyam ।
bilvavriksham prayachchhami hyekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 6 ॥

darshanam bilvavrikshasya sparshanam papanashanam ।
aghorapapasamharam ekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 7 ॥

kashikshetravivasam cha kalabhairavadarshanam ।
prayagamadhavam drishtva hyekabilvam shivarpanam ॥

moolato brahmarupaya madhyato vishnurupine ।
agratah shivarupaya hyekabilvam shivarpanam ॥ 8 ॥

bilvashtakamidam punyam yah pathet shivasannidhau ।
sarvapapa vinirmuktah shivalokamavapnuyat ॥

          ॥ Iti Bilvashtakam ॥

faq.q1: What is Bilvashtakam and where is it from?
faq.a1: Bilvashtakam is a sacred stotra dedicated to the glory and significance of offering Bilva (bael) leaves to Lord Shiva. It is traditionally sourced from scriptural texts such as the Shiva Purana.
faq.q2: What is the main significance and purpose of Bilvashtakam?
faq.a2: The main purpose of this stotra is to highlight the supreme importance of offering a Bilva leaf to Lord Shiva. It emphasizes that offering even a single Bilva leaf with devotion yields spiritual merits equivalent to grand ritualistic sacrifices, great charities, and holy pilgrimages.
faq.q3: How many verses are there in Bilvashtakam?
faq.a3: True to its name, Bilvashtakam contains 8 main verses of praise, along with a phalashruti (fruit-bearing) verse at the conclusion.
faq.q4: What are the benefits of reciting Bilvashtakam?
faq.a4: Regular and sincere recitation cleanses the devotee of all accumulated sins and ultimately grants them the supreme abode of Lord Shiva (Shivlok).
faq.q5: When and how should Bilvashtakam be recited?
faq.a5: It is best recited during the daily worship of Lord Shiva, especially on Mondays, during Pradosh Vrat, and on Maha Shivratri, ideally while offering fresh Bilva leaves to the Shiva Linga.
